  │  64 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │  66 + def cauchy_riemann_check(u: Callable[[Fraction, Fraction], Fraction],                                                                            │

  │  71 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  72 +     For f(z) = u(x,y) + i*v(x,y) to be holomorphic, the partial derivatives                                                                      │
  │  73 +     must satisfy the Cauchy-Riemann equations.                                                                                                   │

  │ 120 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 121 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 122 +         f: Complex function to integrate                                                                                                         │
  │ 123 +         path_points: List of points along the contour                                                                                            │

  │ 136 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 137 +     total = ComplexFraction(Fraction(0), Fraction(0))                                                                                            │
  │ 138 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 139 +     for i in range(len(path_points) - 1):                                                                                                        │

  │ 142 +         dz = z_next - z_k                                                                                                                        │

  │ 145 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │ 151 +     )                                                                                                                                            │

  │ 153 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │ 155 + def residue_at_pole(f: Callable[[ComplexFraction], ComplexFraction],                                                                             │
  │ 156 +                      pole: ComplexFraction,                                                                                                      │
  │ 157 +                      radius: Fraction,                                                                                                           │
  │ 158 +                      n_points: int = 100) -> Tuple[ComplexFraction, ProofObject]:                                                                │
  │ 159 +     """Numerical residue via contour integral around pole.                                                                                       │
  │ 160 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 161 +     For a simple pole at z₀: Res(f, z₀) = (1/2πi) ∮ f(z) dz                                                                                      │
  │ 162 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 163 +     Computes the integral around a circle of given radius centered at pole.                                                                      │
  │ 164 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 165 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 166 +         f: Complex function                                                                                                                      │
  │ 167 +         pole: Location of the pole                                                                                                               │
  │ 168 +         radius: Radius of contour circle                                                                                                         │
  │ 169 +         n_points: Number of points for discretization                                                                                            │
  │ 170 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │ 172 +         (residue_estimate, proof)                                                                                                                │

  │ 174 +     from math import pi, cos, sin                                                                                                                │
  │ 175 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │ 177 +     path_points = []                                                                                                                             │
  │ 178 +     for k in range(n_points):                                                                                                                    │
  │ 179 +         theta = 2 * pi * k / n_points                                                                                                            │
  │ 180 +         # Approximate e^(iθ) = cos(θ) + i*sin(θ) using Fraction approximations                                                                   │
  │ 181 +         # Use simple rational approximations                                                                                                     │
  │ 182 +         cos_approx = Fraction(int(cos(theta) * 1000), 1000)                                                                                      │
  │ 183 +         sin_approx = Fraction(int(sin(theta) * 1000), 1000)                                                                                      │
  │ 184 +         point = pole + ComplexFraction(radius * cos_approx, radius * sin_approx)                                                                 │
  │ 185 +         path_points.append(point)                                                                                                                │
  │ 186 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 187 +     # Close the path                                                                                                                             │
  │ 188 +     path_points.append(path_points[0])                                                                                                           │
  │ 189 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 190 +     # Compute contour integral                                                                                                                   │
  │ 191 +     integral, _ = contour_integral(f, path_points)                                                                                               │
  │ 192 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 193 +     # Residue = integral / (2πi)                                                                                                                 │
  │ 194 +     # 1/i = -i, so integral / (2πi) = -i * integral / (2π)                                                                                       │
  │ 195 +     two_pi = Fraction(6283, 1000)  # Approximation of 2π                                                                                         │
  │ 196 +     residue = ComplexFraction(                                                                                                                   │
  │ 197 +         integral.imag / two_pi,  # Real part comes from imag of integral                                                                         │
  │ 198 +         -integral.real / two_pi   # Imag part comes from -real of integral                                                                       │
  │ 199 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 200 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 201 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 202 +         conclusion=f"Residue at {pole} ≈ {residue}",                                                                                             │
  │ 203 +         premises=[f"Contour integral = {integral}", f"Radius = {radius}"],                                                                       │
  │ 204 +         rule="residue_numerical",                                                                                                                │
  │ 205 +         derivation=[f"Computed via {n_points}-point discretization of circular contour"]                                                         │
  │ 206 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 207 +     return residue, proof                                                                                                                        │

  │ 210 + def fundamental_theorem_of_algebra_witness(coefficients: List[Fraction],                                                                         │
  │ 211 +                                            max_iterations: int = 100) -> Tuple[ComplexFraction, ProofObject]:                                    │
  │ 212 +     """For polynomial with Fraction coefficients, find approximate root via Newton's method.                                                     │
  │ 213 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 214 +     Fundamental Theorem of Algebra: Every non-constant polynomial has at least one root.                                                         │
  │ 215 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 216 +     This function constructs a witness by finding an approximate root.                                                                           │
  │ 217 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 218 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 219 +         coefficients: [a₀, a₁, ..., aₙ] for polynomial a₀ + a₁z + ... + aₙzⁿ                                                                     │
  │ 220 +         max_iterations: Maximum Newton iterations                                                                                                │
  │ 221 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 222 +     Returns:                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 223 +         (approximate_root, proof)                                                                                                                │
  │ 224 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 225 +     if len(coefficients) < 2:                                                                                                                    │
  │ 226 +         proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                     │
  │ 227 +             conclusion="No root found (constant polynomial)",                                                                                    │
  │ 228 +             premises=["Degree < 1"],                                                                                                             │
  │ 229 +             rule="ftoa_constant",                                                                                                                │
  │ 230 +             derivation=[]                                                                                                                        │
  │ 231 +         )                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 232 +         return ComplexFraction(Fraction(0), Fraction(0)), proof                                                                                  │
  │ 233 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 234 +     def poly(z: ComplexFraction) -> ComplexFraction:                                                                                             │
  │ 235 +         """Evaluate polynomial at z."""                                                                                                          │
  │ 236 +         result = ComplexFraction(Fraction(0), Fraction(0))                                                                                       │
  │ 237 +         power = ComplexFraction(Fraction(1), Fraction(0))  # z^0 = 1                                                                             │
  │ 238 +         for coeff in coefficients:                                                                                                               │
  │ 239 +             result = result + ComplexFraction(coeff, Fraction(0)) * power                                                                        │
  │ 240 +             power = power * z                                                                                                                    │
  │ 241 +         return result                                                                                                                            │
  │ 242 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 243 +     def poly_derivative(z: ComplexFraction) -> ComplexFraction:                                                                                  │
  │ 244 +         """Evaluate derivative at z."""                                                                                                          │
  │ 245 +         result = ComplexFraction(Fraction(0), Fraction(0))                                                                                       │
  │ 246 +         power = ComplexFraction(Fraction(1), Fraction(0))                                                                                        │
  │ 247 +         for i, coeff in enumerate(coefficients[1:], 1):                                                                                          │
  │ 248 +             result = result + ComplexFraction(coeff * i, Fraction(0)) * power                                                                    │
  │ 249 +             power = power * z                                                                                                                    │
  │ 250 +         return result                                                                                                                            │
  │ 251 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 252 +     # Initial guess                                                                                                                              │
  │ 253 +     z = ComplexFraction(Fraction(1), Fraction(1))                                                                                                │
  │ 254 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 255 +     for i in range(max_iterations):                                                                                                              │
  │ 256 +         pz = poly(z)                                                                                                                             │
  │ 257 +         dpz = poly_derivative(z)                                                                                                                 │
  │ 258 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 259 +         # Check if converged                                                                                                                     │
  │ 260 +         if pz.modulus_squared() < Fraction(1, 1000000):                                                                                          │
  │ 261 +             proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                 │
  │ 262 +                 conclusion=f"Root found: z ≈ {z}",                                                                                               │
  │ 263 +                 premises=[f"Newton's method converged in {i+1} iterations"],                                                                     │
  │ 264 +                 rule="ftoa_witness",                                                                                                             │
  │ 265 +                 derivation=[f"Final |p(z)|² = {pz.modulus_squared()}"]                                                                           │
  │ 266 +             )                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 267 +             return z, proof                                                                                                                      │
  │ 268 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 269 +         # Newton step: z_{n+1} = z_n - p(z_n)/p'(z_n)                                                                                            │
  │ 270 +         if dpz.modulus_squared() == 0:                                                                                                           │
  │ 271 +             break                                                                                                                                │
  │ 272 +         z = z - pz / dpz                                                                                                                         │
  │ 273 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 274 +     # Return best approximation                                                                                                                  │
  │ 275 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 276 +         conclusion=f"Approximate root: z ≈ {z}",                                                                                                 │
  │ 277 +         premises=[f"Newton's method completed {max_iterations} iterations"],                                                                     │
  │ 278 +         rule="ftoa_approximation",                                                                                                               │
  │ 279 +         derivation=[f"Final |p(z)|² = {poly(z).modulus_squared()}"]                                                                              │
  │ 280 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 281 +     return z, proof                                                                                                                              │

  │  89 + @dataclass                                                                                                                                       │
  │  90 + class SchnorrProtocol:                                                                                                                           │
  │  91 +     """Schnorr protocol for proving knowledge of discrete logarithm.                                                                             │
  │  92 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  93 +     Prover knows x such that y = g^x (mod p).                                                                                                    │
  │  94 +     Protocol proves knowledge of x without revealing x.                                                                                          │
  │  95 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  96 +     Uses small prime for demonstration; production would use large safe prime.                                                                   │
  │  97 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │  98 +     # Public parameters (small for demonstration)                                                                                                │
  │  99 +     p: int = 23  # Prime modulus                                                                                                                 │
  │ 100 +     g: int = 5   # Generator                                                                                                                     │
  │ 101 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 102 +     def generate_challenge(self, commitment: str, statement: str) -> int:                                                                        │
  │ 103 +         """Generate challenge using Fiat-Shamir heuristic.                                                                                       │
  │ 104 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 105 +         challenge = H(commitment || statement) mod (p-1)                                                                                         │
  │ 106 +         """                                                                                                                                      │
  │ 107 +         data = (commitment + statement).encode('utf-8')                                                                                          │
  │ 108 +         hash_val = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()                                                                                              │
  │ 109 +         return int(hash_val, 16) % (self.p - 1)                                                                                                  │
  │ 110 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 111 +     def prove(self, secret_x: int, challenge: int) -> Tuple[int, ProofObject]:                                                                   │
  │ 112 +         """Prover generates response: s = r + c*x where r is random.                                                                             │
  │ 113 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 114 +         In actual Schnorr, prover first sends t = g^r, then computes s.                                                                          │
  │ 115 +         Here we simulate the full protocol flow.                                                                                                 │
  │ 116 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 117 +         Args:                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 118 +             secret_x: The secret exponent (knowledge being proved)                                                                               │
  │ 119 +             challenge: Challenge from verifier                                                                                                   │
  │ 120 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │ 124 +         # Prover's random value                                                                                                                  │
  │ 125 +         r = secrets.randbelow(self.p - 1)                                                                                                        │
  │ 126 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │ 129 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │ 133 +             rule="schnorr_prove",                                                                                                                │
  │ 134 +             derivation=[f"s = r + c*x = {r} + {challenge}*{secret_x} = {response} (mod {self.p-1})"]                                             │
  │ 135 +         )                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 136 +         return response, proof                                                                                                                   │
  │ 137 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 138 +     def verify(self, public_y: int, commitment_t: int, challenge: int, response: int) -> Tuple[bool, ProofObject]:                               │
  │ 139 +         """Verify Schnorr proof.                                                                                                                 │
  │ 140 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 141 +         Check: g^s ≡ t * y^c (mod p)                                                                                                             │
  │ 142 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 143 +         Args:                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 144 +             public_y: Public value y = g^x                                                                                                       │
  │ 145 +             commitment_t: Prover's commitment t = g^r                                                                                            │
  │ 146 +             challenge: Challenge value c                                                                                                         │
  │ 147 +             response: Prover's response s                                                                                                        │
  │ 148 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 149 +         Returns:                                                                                                                                 │
  │ 150 +             (valid, proof)                                                                                                                       │
  │ 151 +         """                                                                                                                                      │
  │ 152 +         lhs = pow(self.g, response, self.p)                                                                                                      │
  │ 153 +         rhs = (commitment_t * pow(public_y, challenge, self.p)) % self.p                                                                         │
  │ 154 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 155 +         valid = lhs == rhs                                                                                                                       │
  │ 156 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 157 +         proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                     │
  │ 158 +             conclusion=f"Schnorr proof {'valid' if valid else 'INVALID'}",                                                                       │
  │ 159 +             premises=[f"g^s mod p = {lhs}", f"t*y^c mod p = {rhs}"],                                                                             │
  │ 160 +             rule="schnorr_verify",                                                                                                               │
  │ 161 +             derivation=[f"Verification: g^s ≡ t * y^c (mod {self.p})"]                                                                           │
  │ 162 +         )                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 163 +         return valid, proof                                                                                                                      │
  │ 164 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 165 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 166 + def zk_completeness_check(protocol: SchnorrProtocol, secret_x: int) -> Tuple[bool, ProofObject]:                                                 │
  │ 167 +     """Verify that honest prover always convinces honest verifier.                                                                               │
  │ 168 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 169 +     Completeness: If prover knows x and follows protocol, verifier accepts.                                                                      │
  │ 170 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │ 210 + def zk_soundness_check(protocol: SchnorrProtocol, fake_secret: int) -> Tuple[bool, ProofObject]:                                                 │
  │ 211 +     """Verify that dishonest prover fails with high probability.                                                                                 │
  │ 212 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 213 +     Soundness: If prover doesn't know x, verifier rejects with high probability.                                                                 │
  │ 214 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 215 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │

  │ 236 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │ 242 +         # against the REAL public key. Here we simulate the check.                                                                               │
  │ 243 +         # (The fake_y was computed from fake_secret, so it would pass against fake_y                                                             │
  │ 244 +         # but fail against the real public key)                                                                                                  │
  │ 245 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │ 247 +         random_s = secrets.randbelow(protocol.p - 1)                                                                                             │
  │ 248 +         if not protocol.verify(fake_y, t, c, random_s)[0]:                                                                                       │
  │ 249 +             rejections += 1                                                                                                                      │
  │ 250 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 251 +     # Soundness: random responses should fail most of the time                                                                                   │
  │ 252 +     rejection_rate = rejections / trials                                                                                                         │
  │ 253 +     sound = rejection_rate > 0.5  # Expect >50% rejection for random responses                                                                   │
  │ 254 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 255 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 256 +         conclusion=f"Soundness {'verified' if sound else 'FAILED'}",                                                                             │
  │ 257 +         premises=[f"Rejection rate: {rejection_rate:.0%} ({rejections}/{trials})"],                                                              │
  │ 258 +         rule="zk_soundness",                                                                                                                     │
  │ 259 +         derivation=["Dishonest prover rejected as expected"]                                                                                     │
  │ 260 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 261 +     return sound, proof                                                                                                                          │
  │ 262 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 263 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 264 + def hash_based_zkp(statement: str, witness: str) -> Tuple[dict, ProofObject]:                                                                    │
  │ 265 +     """Fiat-Shamir heuristic: challenge = H(commitment || statement).                                                                            │
  │ 266 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 267 +     Creates a non-interactive ZK proof from an interactive one.                                                                                  │
  │ 268 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │ 271 +         witness: Secret witness                                                                                                                  │

  │ 291 +     }                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 292 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 293 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 294 +         conclusion="Fiat-Shamir ZKP constructed",                                                                                                │
  │ 295 +         premises=[f"Statement: {statement[:50]}..." if len(statement) > 50 else f"Statement: {statement}"],                                      │
  │ 296 +         rule="fiat_shamir",                                                                                                                      │
  │ 297 +         derivation=["challenge = H(commitment || statement)"]                                                                                    │
  │ 298 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 299 +     return proof_dict, proof                                                                                                                     │
