  │ 108 +                 premises=[f"State {state} satisfies {prop}"],                                                                                    │
  │ 109 +                 rule="ltl_eventually_true",                                                                                                      │
  │ 110 +                 derivation=[f"Path: {' -> '.join(path[:i+1])}"]                                                                                  │
  │ 111 +             )                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 112 +             return True, proof                                                                                                                   │
  │ 113 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 114 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 115 +         conclusion=f"F({prop}) not yet satisfied on path prefix",                                                                                │
  │ 116 +         premises=[f"No state in {len(path)} states satisfies {prop}"],                                                                           │
  │ 117 +         rule="ltl_eventually_pending",                                                                                                           │
  │ 118 +         derivation=[f"Path: {' -> '.join(path)}"]                                                                                                │
  │ 119 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 120 +     return False, proof                                                                                                                          │
  │ 121 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 122 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 123 + def ltl_until(structure: KripkeStructure, p: str, q: str, path: Path) -> Tuple[bool, ProofObject]:                                               │
  │ 124 +     """LTL U (Until): p holds until q holds.                                                                                                     │
  │ 125 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 126 +     p U q is true on path π iff:                                                                                                                 │
  │ 127 +     - q holds at some position j, AND                                                                                                            │
  │ 128 +     - p holds at all positions i < j                                                                                                             │
  │ 129 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 130 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 131 +         structure: The Kripke structure                                                                                                          │
  │ 132 +         p: Proposition that must hold until q                                                                                                    │
  │ 133 +         q: Proposition that must eventually hold                                                                                                 │
  │ 134 +         path: Finite path (prefix) to verify                                                                                                     │
  │ 135 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 136 +     Returns:                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 137 +         (holds, proof)                                                                                                                           │
  │ 138 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 139 +     for j, state in enumerate(path):                                                                                                             │
  │ 140 +         if q in structure.labels.get(state, frozenset()):                                                                                        │
  │ 141 +             # Check that p held at all previous positions                                                                                        │
  │ 142 +             for i in range(j):                                                                                                                   │
  │ 143 +                 if p not in structure.labels.get(path[i], frozenset()):                                                                          │
  │ 144 +                     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                         │
  │ 145 +                         conclusion=f"({p} U {q}) FALSE",                                                                                         │
  │ 146 +                         premises=[f"{p} failed at position {i} before {q} at {j}"],                                                              │
  │ 147 +                         rule="ltl_until_false",                                                                                                  │
  │ 148 +                         derivation=[f"Path: {' -> '.join(path[:j+1])}"]                                                                          │
  │ 149 +                     )                                                                                                                            │
  │ 150 +                     return False, proof                                                                                                          │
  │ 151 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 152 +             proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                 │
  │ 153 +                 conclusion=f"({p} U {q}) TRUE at position {j}",                                                                                  │
  │ 154 +                 premises=[f"{q} holds at {state}, {p} held until then"],                                                                         │
  │ 155 +                 rule="ltl_until_true",                                                                                                           │
  │ 156 +                 derivation=[f"Path: {' -> '.join(path[:j+1])}"]                                                                                  │
  │ 157 +             )                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 158 +             return True, proof                                                                                                                   │
  │ 159 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 160 +         # q hasn't held yet, so p must hold here                                                                                                 │
  │ 161 +         if p not in structure.labels.get(state, frozenset()):                                                                                    │
  │ 162 +             proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                 │
  │ 163 +                 conclusion=f"({p} U {q}) FALSE",                                                                                                 │
  │ 164 +                 premises=[f"Neither {p} nor {q} holds at position {j}"],                                                                         │
  │ 165 +                 rule="ltl_until_false",                                                                                                          │
  │ 166 +                 derivation=[f"Path: {' -> '.join(path[:j+1])}"]                                                                                  │
  │ 167 +             )                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 168 +             return False, proof                                                                                                                  │
  │ 169 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 170 +     # Reached end of path without q holding                                                                                                      │
  │ 171 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 172 +         conclusion=f"({p} U {q}) pending (q not yet reached)",                                                                                   │
  │ 173 +         premises=[f"Path ended with {p} holding but {q} not seen"],                                                                              │
  │ 174 +         rule="ltl_until_pending",                                                                                                                │
  │ 175 +         derivation=[f"Path: {' -> '.join(path)}"]                                                                                                │
  │ 176 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 177 +     return False, proof                                                                                                                          │
  │ 178 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 179 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 180 + def ltl_next(structure: KripkeStructure, prop: str, path: Path, index: int = 0) -> Tuple[bool, ProofObject]:                                     │
  │ 181 +     """LTL X (Next): prop holds at the next state.                                                                                               │
  │ 182 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 183 +     X(p) is true at position i iff p holds at position i+1.                                                                                      │
  │ 184 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 185 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 186 +         structure: The Kripke structure                                                                                                          │
  │ 187 +         prop: Atomic proposition to check                                                                                                        │
  │ 188 +         path: Finite path                                                                                                                        │
  │ 189 +         index: Current position in path                                                                                                          │
  │ 190 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 191 +     Returns:                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 192 +         (holds, proof)                                                                                                                           │
  │ 193 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 194 +     if index + 1 >= len(path):                                                                                                                   │
  │ 195 +         proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                     │
  │ 196 +             conclusion=f"X({prop}) undefined (end of path)",                                                                                     │
  │ 197 +             premises=[f"No next state at position {index}"],                                                                                     │
  │ 198 +             rule="ltl_next_undefined",                                                                                                           │
  │ 199 +             derivation=[]                                                                                                                        │
  │ 200 +         )                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 201 +         return False, proof                                                                                                                      │
  │ 202 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 203 +     next_state = path[index + 1]                                                                                                                 │
  │ 204 +     holds = prop in structure.labels.get(next_state, frozenset())                                                                                │
  │ 205 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 206 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 207 +         conclusion=f"X({prop}) {'TRUE' if holds else 'FALSE'} at position {index}",                                                              │
  │ 208 +         premises=[f"Next state {next_state} {'satisfies' if holds else 'does not satisfy'} {prop}"],                                             │
  │ 209 +         rule="ltl_next_check",                                                                                                                   │
  │ 210 +         derivation=[f"Path: {' -> '.join(path[index:index+2])}"]                                                                                 │
  │ 211 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 212 +     return holds, proof                                                                                                                          │
  │ 213 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 214 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 215 + def ctl_exists_globally(structure: KripkeStructure, prop: str, start: str, max_depth: int = 100) -> Tuple[bool, ProofObject]:                    │
  │ 216 +     """CTL EG: Exists a path from start where G(prop) holds.                                                                                     │
  │ 217 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 218 +     EG(p) is true at state s iff there exists a path from s where p holds globally.                                                              │
  │ 219 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 220 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 221 +         structure: The Kripke structure                                                                                                          │
  │ 222 +         prop: Atomic proposition                                                                                                                 │
  │ 223 +         start: Starting state                                                                                                                    │
  │ 224 +         max_depth: Maximum search depth                                                                                                          │
  │ 225 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 226 +     Returns:                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 227 +         (exists, proof)                                                                                                                          │
  │ 228 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 229 +     # EG(p) = p AND EX(EG(p)) - greatest fixed point                                                                                             │
  │ 230 +     # Simplified: check if there's a reachable cycle where p always holds                                                                        │
  │ 231 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 232 +     visited = set()                                                                                                                              │
  │ 233 +     queue = [(start, [start])]                                                                                                                   │
  │ 234 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 235 +     while queue and len(visited) < max_depth:                                                                                                    │
  │ 236 +         state, path = queue.pop(0)                                                                                                               │
  │ 237 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 238 +         if state in visited:                                                                                                                     │
  │ 239 +             # Found a cycle - check if p holds on the cycle                                                                                      │
  │ 240 +             cycle_start = path.index(state)                                                                                                      │
  │ 241 +             cycle = path[cycle_start:]                                                                                                           │
  │ 242 +             if all(prop in structure.labels.get(s, frozenset()) for s in cycle):                                                                 │
  │ 243 +                 proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                             │
  │ 244 +                     conclusion=f"EG({prop}) TRUE from {start}",                                                                                  │
  │ 245 +                     premises=[f"Cycle found where {prop} always holds"],                                                                         │
  │ 246 +                     rule="ctl_eg_true",                                                                                                          │
  │ 247 +                     derivation=[f"Cycle: {' -> '.join(cycle)}"]                                                                                  │
  │ 248 +                 )                                                                                                                                │
  │ 249 +                 return True, proof                                                                                                               │
  │ 250 +             continue                                                                                                                             │
  │ 251 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 252 +         visited.add(state)                                                                                                                       │
  │ 253 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 254 +         # Check if p holds at current state                                                                                                      │
  │ 255 +         if prop not in structure.labels.get(state, frozenset()):                                                                                 │
  │ 256 +             continue  # p doesn't hold, can't extend this path                                                                                   │
  │ 257 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 258 +         # Explore successors                                                                                                                     │
  │ 259 +         for succ in structure.successors(state):                                                                                                 │
  │ 260 +             if prop in structure.labels.get(succ, frozenset()):                                                                                  │
  │ 261 +                 new_path = path + [succ]                                                                                                         │
  │ 262 +                 queue.append((succ, new_path))                                                                                                   │
  │ 263 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 264 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 265 +         conclusion=f"EG({prop}) FALSE from {start}",                                                                                             │
  │ 266 +         premises=[f"No path found where {prop} holds globally"],                                                                                 │
  │ 267 +         rule="ctl_eg_false",                                                                                                                     │
  │ 268 +         derivation=[f"Explored {len(visited)} states"]                                                                                           │
  │ 269 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 270 +     return False, proof                                                                                                                          │
  │ 271 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 272 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 273 + def ctl_forall_eventually(structure: KripkeStructure, prop: str, start: str, max_depth: int = 100) -> Tuple[bool, ProofObject]:                  │
  │ 274 +     """CTL AF: On all paths from start, F(prop) holds.                                                                                           │
  │ 275 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 276 +     AF(p) is true at state s iff on all paths from s, p eventually holds.                                                                        │
  │ 277 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 278 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 279 +         structure: The Kripke structure                                                                                                          │
  │ 280 +         prop: Atomic proposition                                                                                                                 │
  │ 281 +         start: Starting state                                                                                                                    │
  │ 282 +         max_depth: Maximum search depth                                                                                                          │
  │ 283 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 284 +     Returns:                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 285 +         (holds, proof)                                                                                                                           │
  │ 286 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 287 +     # AF(p) = p OR AX(AF(p)) - least fixed point                                                                                                 │
  │ 288 +     # Simplified: BFS to check all paths                                                                                                         │
  │ 289 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 290 +     # States that satisfy p                                                                                                                      │
  │ 291 +     satisfying = {s for s in structure.states if prop in structure.labels.get(s, frozenset())}                                                   │
  │ 292 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 293 +     # If start already satisfies p                                                                                                               │
  │ 294 +     if start in satisfying:                                                                                                                      │
  │ 295 +         proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                     │
  │ 296 +             conclusion=f"AF({prop}) TRUE at {start}",                                                                                            │
  │ 297 +             premises=[f"{start} immediately satisfies {prop}"],                                                                                  │
  │ 298 +             rule="ctl_af_true_immediate",                                                                                                        │
  │ 299 +             derivation=[]                                                                                                                        │
  │ 300 +         )                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 301 +         return True, proof                                                                                                                       │
  │ 302 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 303 +     # BFS: track states reachable without hitting p                                                                                              │
  │ 304 +     visited = {start}                                                                                                                            │
  │ 305 +     frontier = {start}                                                                                                                           │
  │ 306 +     depth = 0                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 307 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 308 +     while frontier and depth < max_depth:                                                                                                        │
  │ 309 +         new_frontier = set()                                                                                                                     │
  │ 310 +         for state in frontier:                                                                                                                   │
  │ 311 +             for succ in structure.successors(state):                                                                                             │
  │ 312 +                 if succ in satisfying:                                                                                                           │
  │ 313 +                     continue  # This path satisfies p                                                                                            │
  │ 314 +                 if succ not in visited:                                                                                                          │
  │ 315 +                     visited.add(succ)                                                                                                            │
  │ 316 +                     new_frontier.add(succ)                                                                                                       │
  │ 317 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 318 +         # If no new states and we haven't found p, check for deadlock                                                                            │
  │ 319 +         if not new_frontier:                                                                                                                     │
  │ 320 +             # All paths either hit p or reached a deadlock                                                                                       │
  │ 321 +             proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                 │
  │ 322 +                 conclusion=f"AF({prop}) TRUE at {start}",                                                                                        │
  │ 323 +                 premises=[f"All paths from {start} eventually reach {prop}"],                                                                    │
  │ 324 +                 rule="ctl_af_true",                                                                                                              │
  │ 325 +                 derivation=[f"Explored {len(visited)} states"]                                                                                   │
  │ 326 +             )                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 327 +             return True, proof                                                                                                                   │
  │ 328 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 329 +         frontier = new_frontier                                                                                                                  │
  │ 330 +         depth += 1                                                                                                                               │
  │ 331 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 332 +     # Found states that can avoid p indefinitely                                                                                                 │
  │ 333 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 334 +         conclusion=f"AF({prop}) might be FALSE at {start}",                                                                                      │
  │ 335 +         premises=[f"States found that can avoid {prop}"],                                                                                        │
  │ 336 +         rule="ctl_af_maybe_false",                                                                                                               │
  │ 337 +         derivation=[f"Depth limit {max_depth} reached"]                                                                                          │
  │ 338 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 339 +     return False, proof                                                                                                                          │
  │ 340 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 341 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 342 + def model_check(structure: KripkeStructure, formula: str, start: str) -> Tuple[bool, ProofObject]:                                               │
  │ 343 +     """Full CTL model checking via fixed-point iteration.                                                                                        │
  │ 344 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 345 +     Simple formula parser for basic CTL formulas:                                                                                                │
  │ 346 +     - "p" : atomic proposition                                                                                                                   │
  │ 347 +     - "EG p" : exists globally p                                                                                                                 │
  │ 348 +     - "AF p" : forall eventually p                                                                                                               │
  │ 349 +     - "EX p" : exists next p                                                                                                                     │
  │ 350 +     - "AG p" : forall globally p                                                                                                                 │
  │ 351 +     - "EF p" : exists eventually p                                                                                                               │
  │ 352 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 353 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 354 +         structure: The Kripke structure                                                                                                          │
  │ 355 +         formula: CTL formula string                                                                                                              │
  │ 356 +         start: Starting state                                                                                                                    │
  │ 357 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 358 +     Returns:                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 359 +         (satisfies, proof)                                                                                                                       │
  │ 360 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 361 +     parts = formula.strip().split()                                                                                                              │
  │ 362 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 363 +     if len(parts) == 1:                                                                                                                          │
  │ 364 +         # Atomic proposition                                                                                                                     │
  │ 365 +         prop = parts[0]                                                                                                                          │
  │ 366 +         holds = prop in structure.labels.get(start, frozenset())                                                                                 │
  │ 367 +         proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                     │
  │ 368 +             conclusion=f"{formula} is {holds} at {start}",                                                                                       │
  │ 369 +             premises=[f"Labels at {start}: {structure.labels.get(start, frozenset())}"],                                                         │
  │ 370 +             rule="atomic_check",                                                                                                                 │
  │ 371 +             derivation=[]                                                                                                                        │
  │ 372 +         )                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 373 +         return holds, proof                                                                                                                      │
  │ 374 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 375 +     if len(parts) == 2:                                                                                                                          │
  │ 376 +         operator, prop = parts                                                                                                                   │
  │ 377 +         if operator == "EG":                                                                                                                     │
  │ 378 +             return ctl_exists_globally(structure, prop, start)                                                                                   │
  │ 379 +         elif operator == "AF":                                                                                                                   │
  │ 380 +             return ctl_forall_eventually(structure, prop, start)                                                                                 │
  │ 381 +         elif operator == "EX":                                                                                                                   │
  │ 382 +             # Exists next: some successor satisfies prop                                                                                         │
  │ 383 +             for succ in structure.successors(start):                                                                                             │
  │ 384 +                 if prop in structure.labels.get(succ, frozenset()):                                                                              │
  │ 385 +                     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                         │
  │ 386 +                         conclusion=f"EX({prop}) TRUE at {start}",                                                                                │
  │ 387 +                         premises=[f"Successor {succ} satisfies {prop}"],                                                                         │
  │ 388 +                         rule="ctl_ex_true",                                                                                                      │
  │ 389 +                         derivation=[]                                                                                                            │
  │ 390 +                     )                                                                                                                            │
  │ 391 +                     return True, proof                                                                                                           │
  │ 392 +             proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                 │
  │ 393 +                 conclusion=f"EX({prop}) FALSE at {start}",                                                                                       │
  │ 394 +                 premises=["No successor satisfies " + prop],                                                                                     │
  │ 395 +                 rule="ctl_ex_false",                                                                                                             │
  │ 396 +                 derivation=[]                                                                                                                    │
  │ 397 +             )                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 398 +             return False, proof                                                                                                                  │
  │ 399 +         elif operator == "AG":                                                                                                                   │
  │ 400 +             # Forall globally: all reachable states satisfy prop                                                                                 │
  │ 401 +             # Check via BFS                                                                                                                      │
  │ 402 +             visited = set()                                                                                                                      │
  │ 403 +             queue = [start]                                                                                                                      │
  │ 404 +             while queue and len(visited) < 1000:                                                                                                 │
  │ 405 +                 state = queue.pop(0)                                                                                                             │
  │ 406 +                 if state in visited:                                                                                                             │
  │ 407 +                     continue                                                                                                                     │
  │ 408 +                 visited.add(state)                                                                                                               │
  │ 409 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 410 +                 if prop not in structure.labels.get(state, frozenset()):                                                                         │
  │ 411 +                     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                         │
  │ 412 +                         conclusion=f"AG({prop}) FALSE at {start}",                                                                               │
  │ 413 +                         premises=[f"State {state} violates {prop}"],                                                                             │
  │ 414 +                         rule="ctl_ag_false",                                                                                                     │
  │ 415 +                         derivation=[]                                                                                                            │
  │ 416 +                     )                                                                                                                            │
  │ 417 +                     return False, proof                                                                                                          │
  │ 418 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 419 +                 queue.extend(structure.successors(state))                                                                                        │
  │ 420 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 421 +             proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                 │
  │ 422 +                 conclusion=f"AG({prop}) TRUE at {start}",                                                                                        │
  │ 423 +                 premises=[f"All {len(visited)} reachable states satisfy {prop}"],                                                                │
  │ 424 +                 rule="ctl_ag_true",                                                                                                              │
  │ 425 +                 derivation=[]                                                                                                                    │
  │ 426 +             )                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 427 +             return True, proof                                                                                                                   │
  │ 428 +         elif operator == "EF":                                                                                                                   │
  │ 429 +             # Exists eventually: some reachable state satisfies prop                                                                             │
  │ 430 +             visited = set()                                                                                                                      │
  │ 431 +             queue = [start]                                                                                                                      │
  │ 432 +             while queue and len(visited) < 1000:                                                                                                 │
  │ 433 +                 state = queue.pop(0)                                                                                                             │
  │ 434 +                 if state in visited:                                                                                                             │
  │ 435 +                     continue                                                                                                                     │
  │ 436 +                 visited.add(state)                                                                                                               │
  │ 437 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 438 +                 if prop in structure.labels.get(state, frozenset()):                                                                             │
  │ 439 +                     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                         │
  │ 440 +                         conclusion=f"EF({prop}) TRUE at {start}",                                                                                │
  │ 441 +                         premises=[f"State {state} satisfies {prop}"],                                                                            │
  │ 442 +                         rule="ctl_ef_true",                                                                                                      │
  │ 443 +                         derivation=[]                                                                                                            │
  │ 444 +                     )                                                                                                                            │
  │ 445 +                     return True, proof                                                                                                           │
  │ 446 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 447 +                 queue.extend(structure.successors(state))                                                                                        │
  │ 448 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 449 +             proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                 │
  │ 450 +                 conclusion=f"EF({prop}) FALSE at {start}",                                                                                       │
  │ 451 +                 premises=[f"No reachable state satisfies {prop}"],                                                                               │
  │ 452 +                 rule="ctl_ef_false",                                                                                                             │
  │ 453 +                 derivation=[]                                                                                                                    │
  │ 454 +             )                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 455 +             return False, proof                                                                                                                  │
  │ 456 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 457 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 458 +         conclusion=f"Formula '{formula}' not recognized",                                                                                        │
  │ 459 +         premises=["Unknown operator or syntax"],                                                                                                 │
  │ 460 +         rule="parse_error",                                                                                                                      │
  │ 461 +         derivation=[]                                                                                                                            │
  │ 462 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 463 +     return False, proof                                                                                                                          │

  │ 218 + def bell_inequality_check(correlations: List[Fraction]) -> Tuple[bool, ProofObject]:                                                             │
  │ 219 +     """Check CHSH inequality: |S| ≤ 2 (classical) vs |S| ≤ 2√2 (quantum).                                                                        │
  │ 220 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 221 +     CHSH inequality: |E(a,b) - E(a,b') + E(a',b) + E(a',b')| ≤ 2                                                                                 │
  │ 222 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 223 +     Quantum mechanics allows up to 2√2 ≈ 2.828.                                                                                                  │
  │ 224 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 225 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 226 +         correlations: Four correlation values E(a,b), E(a,b'), E(a',b), E(a',b')                                                                 │
  │ 227 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 228 +     Returns:                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 229 +         (quantum_correlation_detected, proof)                                                                                                    │
  │ 230 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 231 +     if len(correlations) != 4:                                                                                                                   │
  │ 232 +         raise ValueError("Need exactly 4 correlation values")                                                                                    │
  │ 233 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 234 +     # Compute S = E(a,b) - E(a,b') + E(a',b) + E(a',b')                                                                                          │
  │ 235 +     s = correlations[0] - correlations[1] + correlations[2] + correlations[3]                                                                    │
  │ 236 +     s_abs = abs(s)                                                                                                                               │
  │ 237 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 238 +     # Classical bound: 2                                                                                                                         │
  │ 239 +     classical_bound = Fraction(2)                                                                                                                │
  │ 240 +     # Quantum bound: 2√2 ≈ 2.828                                                                                                                 │
  │ 241 +     sqrt2 = Fraction(1414, 1000)  # Approximation of √2                                                                                          │
  │ 242 +     quantum_bound = 2 * sqrt2                                                                                                                    │
  │ 243 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 244 +     if s_abs <= classical_bound:                                                                                                                 │
  │ 245 +         conclusion = "Satisfies classical CHSH bound"                                                                                            │
  │ 246 +         quantum = False                                                                                                                          │
  │ 247 +     elif s_abs <= quantum_bound:                                                                                                                 │
  │ 248 +         conclusion = "Violates classical but within quantum bound"                                                                               │
  │ 249 +         quantum = True                                                                                                                           │
  │ 250 +     else:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 251 +         conclusion = "Exceeds even quantum bound (check measurement)"                                                                            │
  │ 252 +         quantum = False                                                                                                                          │
  │ 253 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 254 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 255 +         conclusion=f"CHSH: |S| = {s_abs}: {conclusion}",                                                                                         │
  │ 256 +         premises=[f"S = {s}", f"Classical bound: {classical_bound}", f"Quantum bound: {quantum_bound}"],                                         │
  │ 257 +         rule="chsh_check",                                                                                                                       │
  │ 258 +         derivation=[f"Correlations: {correlations}"]                                                                                             │
  │ 259 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 260 +     return quantum, proof                                                                                                                        │

  │ 263 + def no_cloning_theorem(state: QuantumState) -> Tuple[bool, ProofObject]:                                                                         │
  │ 264 +     """Prove no unitary U exists such that U|ψ⟩|0⟩ = |ψ⟩|ψ⟩ for all |ψ⟩.                                                                         │
  │ 265 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 266 +     The no-cloning theorem states that it is impossible to create an identical                                                                   │
  │ 267 +     copy of an arbitrary unknown quantum state.                                                                                                  │
  │ 268 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 269 +     Proof sketch: If such U existed, then for orthogonal states |ψ⟩ and |φ⟩:                                                                     │
  │ 270 +     U|ψ⟩|0⟩ = |ψ⟩|ψ⟩                                                                                                                             │
  │ 271 +     U|φ⟩|0⟩ = |φ⟩|φ⟩                                                                                                                             │
  │ 272 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 273 +     Taking inner product:                                                                                                                        │
  │ 274 +     ⟨ψ|φ⟩ = ⟨ψ|φ⟩²                                                                                                                               │
  │ 275 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 276 +     For orthogonal states ⟨ψ|φ⟩ = 0, this gives 0 = 0 (OK).                                                                                      │
  │ 277 +     For non-orthogonal states, this is a contradiction.                                                                                          │
  │ 278 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 279 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 280 +         state: A quantum state to demonstrate the theorem                                                                                        │
  │ 281 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 282 +     Returns:                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 283 +         (theorem_holds, proof)                                                                                                                   │
  │ 284 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 285 +     # Create two different states                                                                                                                │
  │ 286 +     if len(state.amplitudes) < 2:                                                                                                                │
  │ 287 +         # Create a second state for comparison                                                                                                   │
  │ 288 +         psi = QuantumState([ComplexFraction(Fraction(1), Fraction(0)), ComplexFraction(Fraction(0), Fraction(0))])                               │
  │ 289 +         phi = QuantumState([ComplexFraction(Fraction(1), Fraction(1)) / ComplexFraction(Fraction(2).sqrt() if hasattr(Fraction(1), 'sqrt') else… │
  │ 290 +                            ComplexFraction(Fraction(0), Fraction(0))])                                                                           │
  │ 291 +     else:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 292 +         psi = QuantumState([state.amplitudes[0], state.amplitudes[1] if len(state.amplitudes) > 1 else ComplexFraction(Fraction(0), Fraction(0)… │
  │ 293 +         phi = QuantumState([ComplexFraction(Fraction(1), Fraction(0)), ComplexFraction(Fraction(0), Fraction(0))])                               │
  │ 294 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 295 +     # Compute inner products                                                                                                                     │
  │ 296 +     inner = psi.inner_product(phi)                                                                                                               │
  │ 297 +     inner_sq = ComplexFraction(inner.real * inner.real - inner.imag * inner.imag,                                                                │
  │ 298 +                                 2 * inner.real * inner.imag)                                                                                     │
  │ 299 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 300 +     # For no-cloning: if U existed, we'd need inner = inner²                                                                                     │
  │ 301 +     # This only holds if inner = 0 or inner = 1 (identical or orthogonal states)                                                                 │
  │ 302 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 303 +     holds = not (inner.real == Fraction(0) and inner.imag == Fraction(0)) and \                                                                  │
  │ 304 +             not (inner.real == Fraction(1) and inner.imag == Fraction(0))                                                                        │
  │ 305 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 306 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 307 +         conclusion=f"No-cloning theorem {'confirmed' if holds else 'edge case'}",                                                                │
  │ 308 +         premises=[f"⟨ψ|φ⟩ = {inner}", f"⟨ψ|φ⟩² would need to equal ⟨ψ|φ⟩ for cloning"],                                                          │
  │ 309 +         rule="no_cloning",                                                                                                                       │
  │ 310 +         derivation=["Cloning impossible for non-orthogonal, non-identical states"]                                                               │
  │ 311 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 312 +     return holds, proof                                                                                                                          │

  │ 118 +     def apply_kock_lawvere(self, f: Callable[[Infinitesimal], Microquantity]) -> Tuple[Microquantity, ProofObject]:                              │
  │ 119 +         """Apply Kock-Lawvere axiom: extract standard and infinitesimal parts.                                                                   │
  │ 120 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 121 +         For f(d) = a + b·d, returns (a, b) where:                                                                                                │
  │ 122 +         - a = f(0) is the standard part                                                                                                          │

  │ 124 +                                                                                                                                                  │

  │ 126 +             f: Function from infinitesimals to microquantities                                                                                   │

  │ 129 +             ((a, b), proof) where result = a + b·d                                                                                               │

  │ 131 +         # Evaluate at d = 0 to get standard part                                                                                                 │

  │ 133 +         f_at_0 = f(zero)                                                                                                                         │

  │ 138 +         one_d = Infinitesimal(Fraction(1))                                                                                                       │
  │ 139 +         f_at_d = f(one_d)                                                                                                                        │
  │ 140 +         # f_at_d = a + b·1 = a + b, so b = f_at_d - a                                                                                            │

  │ 149 +             derivation=["By uniqueness in Kock-Lawvere axiom"]                                                                                   │

  │ 154 + def tangent_vector(f: Callable[[Fraction], Fraction], point: Fraction) -> Tuple[Fraction, ProofObject]:                                          │
  │ 155 +     """Extract tangent vector (derivative) using SDG.                                                                                            │
  │ 156 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 157 +     The tangent to f at point is the coefficient b in:                                                                                           │
  │ 158 +     f(point + d) = f(point) + b·d                                                                                                                │
  │ 159 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 160 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 161 +         f: Function R → R                                                                                                                        │
  │ 162 +         point: Point where to compute tangent                                                                                                    │
  │ 163 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 164 +     Returns:                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 165 +         (slope, proof)                                                                                                                           │
  │ 166 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 167 +     # In SDG: f(x + d) = f(x) + f'(x)·d for nilsquare d                                                                                          │
  │ 168 +     # We approximate using finite difference                                                                                                     │
  │ 169 +     h = Fraction(1, 1000000)  # Small but non-zero                                                                                               │
  │ 170 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 171 +     f_at_point = f(point)                                                                                                                        │
  │ 172 +     f_at_point_plus_h = f(point + h)                                                                                                             │
  │ 173 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 174 +     # f(x + h) ≈ f(x) + f'(x)·h                                                                                                                  │
  │ 175 +     # So f'(x) ≈ (f(x+h) - f(x)) / h                                                                                                             │
  │ 176 +     slope = (f_at_point_plus_h - f_at_point) / h                                                                                                 │
  │ 177 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 178 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 179 +         conclusion=f"Tangent vector at {point}: f'({point}) ≈ {slope}",                                                                          │
  │ 180 +         premises=[f"f({point}) = {f_at_point}", f"f({point}+{h}) = {f_at_point_plus_h}"],                                                        │
  │ 181 +         rule="tangent_sdg",                                                                                                                      │
  │ 182 +         derivation=[f"SDG: f(x+d) = f(x) + f'(x)·d"]                                                                                             │
  │ 183 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 184 +     return slope, proof                                                                                                                          │
  │ 185 +                                                                                                                                                  │
