  │ 187 + def lie_bracket(X: Callable[[Fraction], Fraction],                                                                                               │
  │ 188 +                 Y: Callable[[Fraction], Fraction],                                                                                               │
  │ 189 +                 point: Fraction) -> Tuple[Fraction, ProofObject]:                                                                                │
  │ 190 +     """Compute Lie bracket [X,Y] = XY - YX at a point.                                                                                           │
  │ 191 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 192 +     The Lie bracket measures the failure of vector fields to commute.                                                                            │
  │ 193 +     [X,Y](f) = X(Y(f)) - Y(X(f))                                                                                                                 │
  │ 194 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 195 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 196 +         X: First vector field (as function on reals)                                                                                             │
  │ 197 +         Y: Second vector field                                                                                                                   │
  │ 198 +         point: Point where to evaluate                                                                                                           │
  │ 199 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 200 +     Returns:                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 201 +         (bracket_value, proof)                                                                                                                   │
  │ 202 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 203 +     # Approximate X(Y(f)) and Y(X(f)) at point                                                                                                   │
  │ 204 +     h = Fraction(1, 10000)                                                                                                                       │
  │ 205 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 206 +     # X(Y(point)) approximation                                                                                                                  │
  │ 207 +     y_at_point = Y(point)                                                                                                                        │
  │ 208 +     y_at_point_plus_h = Y(point + h)                                                                                                             │
  │ 209 +     dy = (y_at_point_plus_h - y_at_point) / h                                                                                                    │
  │ 210 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 211 +     x_at_point = X(point)                                                                                                                        │
  │ 212 +     x_at_y = X(y_at_point)                                                                                                                       │
  │ 213 +     x_at_y_plus_dy = X(y_at_point + h * dy)                                                                                                      │
  │ 214 +     xy_f = (x_at_y_plus_dy - x_at_y) / h                                                                                                         │
  │ 215 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 216 +     # Y(X(point)) approximation                                                                                                                  │
  │ 217 +     dx = (x_at_point_plus_h := X(point + h))                                                                                                     │
  │ 218 +     dx = (dx - x_at_point) / h                                                                                                                   │
  │ 219 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 220 +     y_at_x = Y(x_at_point)                                                                                                                       │
  │ 221 +     y_at_x_plus_dx = Y(x_at_point + h * dx)                                                                                                      │
  │ 222 +     yx_f = (y_at_x_plus_dx - y_at_x) / h                                                                                                         │
  │ 223 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 224 +     bracket = xy_f - yx_f                                                                                                                        │
  │ 225 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 226 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 227 +         conclusion=f"Lie bracket [X,Y] at {point} ≈ {bracket}",                                                                                  │
  │ 228 +         premises=[f"X(Y(f)) ≈ {xy_f}", f"Y(X(f)) ≈ {yx_f}"],                                                                                     │
  │ 229 +         rule="lie_bracket",                                                                                                                      │
  │ 230 +         derivation=[f"[X,Y] = XY - YX"]                                                                                                          │
  │ 231 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 232 +     return bracket, proof                                                                                                                        │

  │ 235 + def differential_form(f: Callable[[Fraction], Fraction],                                                                                         │
  │ 236 +                      degree: int) -> Tuple[Callable, ProofObject]:                                                                               │
  │ 237 +     """Create exterior derivative of a 0-form (function).                                                                                        │
  │ 238 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 239 +     For a 0-form f, df is a 1-form: df(v) = v(f)                                                                                                 │
  │ 240 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 241 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 242 +         f: Function (0-form)                                                                                                                     │
  │ 243 +         degree: Degree of the form (0 for functions)                                                                                             │
  │ 244 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 245 +     Returns:                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 246 +         (df, proof) where df is the exterior derivative                                                                                          │
  │ 247 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 248 +     if degree != 0:                                                                                                                              │
  │ 249 +         raise ValueError("Only 0-forms supported in this implementation")                                                                        │
  │ 250 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 251 +     def df(vector_field: Callable[[Fraction], Fraction]) -> Callable[[Fraction], Fraction]:                                                      │
  │ 252 +         """df applied to a vector field gives directional derivative."""                                                                         │
  │ 253 +         def result(point: Fraction) -> Fraction:                                                                                                 │
  │ 254 +             h = Fraction(1, 10000)                                                                                                               │
  │ 255 +             # Directional derivative: v(f)(p) ≈ (f(p + h·v(p)) - f(p)) / h                                                                       │
  │ 256 +             v_at_p = vector_field(point)                                                                                                         │
  │ 257 +             return (f(point + h * v_at_p) - f(point)) / h                                                                                        │
  │ 258 +         return result                                                                                                                            │
  │ 259 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 260 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 261 +         conclusion=f"Exterior derivative d(f) created",                                                                                          │
  │ 262 +         premises=[f"0-form f degree: {degree}"],                                                                                                 │
  │ 263 +         rule="exterior_derivative",                                                                                                              │
  │ 264 +         derivation=["df(v) = v(f) by definition"]                                                                                                │
  │ 265 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 266 +     return df, proof                                                                                                                             │
  │ 267 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 268 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 269 + def stokes_theorem_check(form_values: List[Fraction],                                                                                            │
  │ 270 +                          boundary_values: List[Fraction],                                                                                        │
  │ 271 +                          interior_values: List[Fraction]) -> Tuple[bool, ProofObject]:                                                           │
  │ 272 +     """Discrete approximation of Stokes' theorem: ∫_∂M ω = ∫_M dω.                                                                               │
  │ 273 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 274 +     For a discrete mesh, verifies that the sum over boundary faces                                                                               │
  │ 275 +     approximates the sum of the exterior derivative over interior.                                                                               │
  │ 276 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 277 +     Args:                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 278 +         form_values: Values of the form at vertices                                                                                              │
  │ 279 +         boundary_values: Form values on boundary edges/faces                                                                                     │
  │ 280 +         interior_values: Exterior derivative values on interior                                                                                  │
  │ 281 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 282 +     Returns:                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 283 +         (approximation_holds, proof)                                                                                                             │
  │ 284 +     """                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 285 +     # Discrete approximation: sum of boundary values ≈ sum of interior values                                                                    │
  │ 286 +     boundary_sum = sum(boundary_values)                                                                                                          │
  │ 287 +     interior_sum = sum(interior_values)                                                                                                          │
  │ 288 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 289 +     # Check if approximately equal (within tolerance)                                                                                            │
  │ 290 +     diff = abs(boundary_sum - interior_sum)                                                                                                      │
  │ 291 +     tolerance = Fraction(1, 100)                                                                                                                 │
  │ 292 +     holds = diff < tolerance                                                                                                                     │
  │ 293 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 294 +     proof = ProofObject(                                                                                                                         │
  │ 295 +         conclusion=f"Stokes theorem {'verified' if holds else 'approximation large'}",                                                           │
  │ 296 +         premises=[f"∫_∂M ω = {boundary_sum}", f"∫_M dω = {interior_sum}", f"Difference: {diff}"],                                                │
  │ 297 +         rule="stokes_discrete",                                                                                                                  │
  │ 298 +         derivation=[f"Discrete approximation on {len(interior_values)} interior elements"]                                                       │
  │ 299 +     )                                                                                                                                            │
  │ 300 +     return holds, proof                                                                                                                          │

  │ 15 +                                                                                                                                                   │
  │ 16 + /-- P3: 0 is not the successor of any natural number -/                                                                                           │
  │ 17 + theorem zero_not_succ : ∀ n : Nat, Nat.succ n ≠ 0 := by                                                                                           │
  │ 18 +   intro n h                                                                                                                                       │
  │ 19 +   exact absurd h (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)                                                                                                             │
  │ 20 +                                                                                                                                                   │
  │ 21 + /-- P4: Successor is injective -/                                                                                                                 │
  │ 22 + theorem succ_injective : ∀ m n : Nat, Nat.succ m = Nat.succ n → m = n := by                                                                       │
  │ 23 +   intro m n h                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 24 +   exact Nat.succ.inj h                                                                                                                            │
  │ 25 +                                                                                                                                                   │
  │ 26 + /-- P5: Mathematical induction principle -/                                                                                                       │
  │ 27 + theorem induction_principle {P : Nat → Prop}                                                                                                      │
  │ 28 +     (base : P 0)                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 29 +     (step : ∀ n, P n → P (Nat.succ n))                                                                                                            │
  │ 30 +     : ∀ n, P n := by                                                                                                                              │
  │ 31 +   intro n                                                                                                                                         │
  │ 32 +   induction n with                                                                                                                                │
  │ 33 +   | zero => exact base                                                                                                                            │
  │ 34 +   | succ n ih => exact step n ih                                                                                                                  │
  │ 35 +                                                                                                                                                   │
  │ 36 + /-- Addition is defined recursively -/                                                                                                            │
  │ 37 + def peanoAdd (m n : Nat) : Nat :=                                                                                                                 │
  │ 38 +   match n with                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 39 +   | 0 => m                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 40 +   | Nat.succ n' => Nat.succ (peanoAdd m n')                                                                                                       │
  │ 41 +                                                                                                                                                   │
  │ 42 + /-- Multiplication is defined recursively -/                                                                                                      │
  │ 43 + def peanoMul (m n : Nat) : Nat :=                                                                                                                 │
  │ 44 +   match n with                                                                                                                                    │
  │ 45 +   | 0 => 0                                                                                                                                        │
  │ 46 +   | Nat.succ n' => peanoAdd m (peanoMul m n')                                                                                                     │
  │ 47 +                                                                                                                                                   │
  │ 48 + /-- Addition is associative -/                                                                                                                    │
  │ 49 + theorem add_assoc : ∀ a b c : Nat, peanoAdd (peanoAdd a b) c = peanoAdd a (peanoAdd b c) := by                                                    │
  │ 50 +   intro a b c                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 51 +   induction c with                                                                                                                                │
  │ 52 +   | zero => rfl                                                                                                                                   │
  │ 53 +   | succ c ih => simp [peanoAdd, ih]                                                                                                              │
  │ 54 +                                                                                                                                                   │
  │ 55 + /-- Addition is commutative -/                                                                                                                    │
  │ 56 + theorem add_comm : ∀ a b : Nat, peanoAdd a b = peanoAdd b a := by                                                                                 │
  │ 57 +   intro a b                                                                                                                                       │
  │ 58 +   induction b with                                                                                                                                │
  │ 59 +   | zero => simp [peanoAdd]                                                                                                                       │
  │ 60 +   | succ b ih => simp [peanoAdd, ih]                                                                                                              │
  │ 61 +                                                                                                                                                   │
  │ 62 + /-- Multiplication distributes over addition -/                                                                                                   │

  │  71 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  72 + ## For GitHub Copilot: How to Handle YML Permissions                                                                                             │
  │  73 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  74 + ### Understanding the Permission Model                                                                                                           │
  │  75 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  76 + GitHub separates repository content permissions from workflow permissions:                                                                       │
  │  77 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  78 + | Scope | Can Modify | Cannot Modify |                                                                                                           │
  │  79 + |-------|-----------|---------------|                                                                                                            │
  │  80 + | `repo` | Regular files, docs, code | `.github/workflows/*.yml` |                                                                               │
  │  81 + | `workflow` | Everything including workflows | Nothing (full access) |                                                                          │
  │  82 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  83 + ### Recommended Approach for GitHub Copilot                                                                                                      │
  │  84 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  85 + #### Option 1: Use GitHub UI (Recommended for Safety)                                                                                            │
  │  86 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  87 + When Copilot needs to create workflow files:                                                                                                     │
  │  88 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  89 + 1. **Generate the file content** in the conversation                                                                                             │
  │  90 + 2. **Present to user** with clear instructions                                                                                                   │
  │  91 + 3. **User uploads** via GitHub UI at:                                                                                                            │
  │  92 +    - `https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/blob/main/.github/workflows/`                                                                            │
  │  93 +    - Click "Add file" → "Create new file"                                                                                                        │
  │  94 + 4. **Copilot verifies** by checking if workflow appears in Actions tab                                                                           │
  │  95 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  96 + #### Option 2: Use GitHub CLI (If Available)                                                                                                     │
  │  97 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │  98 + If the environment has `gh` CLI with proper authentication:                                                                                      │
  │  99 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 100 + ```bash                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 101 + # Check if gh CLI is available and authenticated                                                                                                 │
  │ 102 + gh auth status                                                                                                                                   │
  │ 103 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 104 + # Create workflow file via API                                                                                                                   │
  │ 105 + gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/.github/workflows/{name}.yml \                                                                              │
  │ 106 +   --method PUT \                                                                                                                                 │
  │ 107 +   --input - <<EOF                                                                                                                                │
  │ 108 + {                                                                                                                                                │
  │ 109 +   "message": "Add workflow",                                                                                                                     │
  │ 110 +   "content": "$(base64 -w 0 < workflow.yml)"                                                                                                     │
  │ 111 + }                                                                                                                                                │
  │ 112 + EOF                                                                                                                                              │
  │ 113 + ```                                                                                                                                              │
  │ 114 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 115 + #### Option 3: Document and Delegate (Current Approach)                                                                                          │
  │ 116 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 117 + When workflow permissions are not available:                                                                                                     │
  │ 118 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 119 + 1. **Create files locally** in a temporary location                                                                                              │
  │ 120 + 2. **Document the limitation** clearly (as done here)                                                                                            │
  │ 121 + 3. **Provide upload instructions** for human or other AI with appropriate access                                                                 │
  │ 122 + 4. **Continue with other tasks** that don't require workflow permissions                                                                         │
  │ 123 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 124 + ### Best Practices for GitHub Copilot                                                                                                            │
  │ 125 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 126 + 1. **Always check permissions first:**                                                                                                           │
  │ 127 +    ```bash                                                                                                                                       │
  │ 128 +    # Test if workflow modifications are allowed                                                                                                  │
  │ 129 +    git push origin main 2>&1 | grep -i "workflow"                                                                                                │
  │ 130 +    ```                                                                                                                                           │
  │ 131 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 132 + 2. **Separate workflow commits from regular commits:**                                                                                           │
  │ 133 +    - Regular commits: Pushed immediately                                                                                                         │
  │ 134 +    - Workflow commits: Saved locally with documentation                                                                                          │
  │ 135 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 136 + 3. **Provide clear handoff documentation:**                                                                                                      │
  │ 137 +    - What files need to be uploaded                                                                                                              │
  │ 138 +    - Where they should go                                                                                                                        │
  │ 139 +    - What configuration is needed (secrets, labels)                                                                                              │
  │ 140 +    - How to test                                                                                                                                 │
  │ 141 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 142 + 4. **Use the `.github/labels.yml` pattern:**                                                                                                     │
  │ 143 +    - Create documentation of required labels                                                                                                     │
  │ 144 +    - Note that labels must be created via UI                                                                                                     │
  │ 145 +    - Don't fail if labels don't exist yet                                                                                                        │
  │ 146 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 147 + ### Token Scope Requirements Reference                                                                                                           │
  │ 148 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 149 + ```yaml                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 150 + # Minimum required for code commits                                                                                                              │
  │ 151 + scopes: repo                                                                                                                                     │
  │ 152 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 153 + # Required for workflow modifications                                                                                                            │
  │ 154 + scopes: repo, workflow                                                                                                                           │
  │ 155 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 156 + # Full access including secrets                                                                                                                  │
  │ 157 + scopes: repo, workflow, admin:repo_hook                                                                                                          │
  │ 158 + ```                                                                                                                                              │
  │ 159 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 160 + ### Testing Workflow Without Push                                                                                                                │
  │ 161 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 162 + To verify workflow syntax before upload:                                                                                                         │
  │ 163 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 164 + ```bash                                                                                                                                          │
  │ 165 + # Validate YAML syntax                                                                                                                           │
  │ 166 + python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/workflow.yml'))"                                                                 │
  │ 167 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 168 + # Use GitHub's workflow schema validation (requires gh CLI)                                                                                      │
  │ 169 + gh workflow run workflow-name.yml --dry-run                                                                                                      │
  │ 170 + ```                                                                                                                                              │
  │ 171 +                                                                                                                                                  │
  │ 172 + ---                                                                                                                                              │
